# Kissing Camels Family Dentistry

> A comprehensive family dental practice in Colorado Springs offering preventative, cosmetic, restorative, and specialized dental services with experienced dentists and advanced technology.

Kissing Camels Family Dentistry is a full-service dental practice located in Colorado Springs, Colorado (80907) serving families and individuals with a range of dental treatments. The practice is led by multiple experienced dentists including Dr. Boals, Dr. Johnson, Dr. Effinger, Dr. Kubeluis, and Dr. Avey, and emphasizes community involvement and patient comfort through sedation options and modern techniques.

## Dental Services

- [Dental Services Overview](https://kissingcamelsfamilydentistry.com/services): Overview of dental services including cosmetic and restorative dentistry
- [Preventative Dentistry](https://kissingcamelsfamilydentistry.com/preventative-dentistry): Preventative dentistry services including cleanings and fluoride treatments
- [Cosmetic Dentistry](https://kissingcamelsfamilydentistry.com/cosmetic-dentistry): Cosmetic dentistry services including veneers and teeth whitening
- [Restorative Dentistry](https://kissingcamelsfamilydentistry.com/restorative-dentistry): Restorative dentistry including implants, crowns, and root canals
- [Dental Implants](https://kissingcamelsfamilydentistry.com/dental-implants-colorado-springs): Dental implants consultation and procedures using 3D imaging technology
- [Root Canal Therapy](https://kissingcamelsfamilydentistry.com/root-canal-therapy): Root canal therapy and endodontic treatment for tooth infections
- [Tooth Extraction](https://kissingcamelsfamilydentistry.com/tooth-extraction): Painless tooth extraction and wisdom teeth removal services

## Specialized Treatments

- [Pediatric Dentistry](https://kissingcamelsfamilydentistry.com/pediatric-dentistry): Pediatric dentistry for infants, children, and teens in Colorado Springs
- [Invisalign Clear Aligners](https://kissingcamelsfamilydentistry.com/invisalign-2): Clear aligners and orthodontic treatment using Clear Correct technology
- [Sedation Dentistry](https://kissingcamelsfamilydentistry.com/sedation-dentistry): Sedation dentistry options including nitrous oxide for dental anxiety
- [Facial Aesthetics](https://kissingcamelsfamilydentistry.com/facial-aesthetics): Facial aesthetics including Botox and Xeomin treatments by Dr. Johnson
- [Dermal Fillers](https://kissingcamelsfamilydentistry.com/filler): Dermal fillers and facial rejuvenation services in Colorado Springs
